AGRICULTURAL SCIENCE

J.K.K. Munirajah College of Agricultural Science is accredited by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research and affiliated with Tamil Nadu Agricultural University. The college is committed to providing quality agricultural education, research, and practical training to nurture skilled agricultural professionals.
